info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks Materials Elasticity API

params.name: material_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of material_id values to query on

params.name: chemsys
params.description: A comma delimited string list of chemical systems.

params.name: k_voigt_max
params.description: Maximum value for the Voigt average of the bulk modulus in GPa.

params.name: k_voigt_min
params.description: Minimum value for the Voigt average of the bulk modulus in GPa.

params.name: k_reuss_max
params.description: Maximum value for the Reuss average of the bulk modulus in GPa.

params.name: k_reuss_min
params.description: Minimum value for the Reuss average of the bulk modulus in GPa.

params.name: k_vrh_max
params.description: Maximum value for the Voigt-Reuss-Hill average of the bulk modulus in GPa.

params.name: k_vrh_min
params.description: Minimum value for the Voigt-Reuss-Hill average of the bulk modulus in GPa.

params.name: g_voigt_max
params.description: Maximum value for the Voigt average of the shear modulus in GPa.

params.name: g_voigt_min
params.description: Minimum value for the Voigt average of the shear modulus in GPa.

params.name: g_reuss_max
params.description: Maximum value for the Reuss average of the shear modulus in GPa.

params.name: g_reuss_min
params.description: Minimum value for the Reuss average of the shear modulus in GPa.

params.name: g_vrh_max
params.description: Maximum value for the Voigt-Reuss-Hill average of the shear modulus in GPa.

params.name: g_vrh_min
params.description: Minimum value for the Voigt-Reuss-Hill average of the shear modulus in GPa.

params.name: elastic_anisotropy_max
params.description: Maximum value for the elastic anisotropy.

params.name: elastic_anisotropy_min
params.description: Maximum value for the elastic anisotropy.

params.name: poisson_max
params.description: Maximum value for Poisson's ratio.

params.name: poisson_min
params.description: Minimum value for Poisson's ratio.

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from ElasticityDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `builder_meta` `nsites` `elements` `nelements` `composition` `composition_reduced` `formula_pretty` `formula_anonymous` `chemsys` `volume` `density` `density_atomic` `symmetry` `material_id` `deprecated` `deprecation_reasons` `last_updated` `origins` `warnings` `structure` `property_name` `order` `elastic_tensor` `compliance_tensor` `bulk_modulus` `shear_modulus` `sound_velocity` `thermal_conductivity` `young_modulus` `universal_anisotropy` `homogeneous_poisson` `debye_temperature` `fitting_data` `fitting_method` `state`

params.name: _all_fields
params.description: Include all fields.
